stories.title: Zeeschip in Eemshaven dreigt niet langer te zinken, lek is gedicht

en.title: Sea vessel in Eemshaven no longer at risk of sinking, leak has been sealed
en.summary: A ship that faced sinking risk in the Eemshaven has been secured after divers inspected and sealed the leak. All crew members had evacuated earlier.

stories.title: Vier agenten liepen gehoorschade op bij azc-protesten in Opheusden en Kesteren

en.title: Four police officers suffered hearing damage during asylum center protests in Opheusden and Kesteren
en.summary: Four officers received medical treatment for hearing damage sustained during recent asylum center protests in two Gelderland villages. The local mayor indicated that outside activist groups were involved.

stories.title: Lek zeeschip in de Eemshaven gedicht, gevaar zinken afgewend

en.title: Leak in sea vessel at Eemshaven sealed, sinking danger averted
en.summary: Divers have sealed a leak in the Nautilus, a 73-by-16-meter cargo ship carrying offshore wind turbine components, preventing it from sinking in the Eemshaven.

stories.title: Zeeschip dat in Eemshaven ligt dreigt te zinken

en.title: Sea vessel at Eemshaven at risk of sinking
en.summary: A ship at the Eemshaven faced sinking risk on Monday evening, prompting emergency services to respond to prevent capsizing.

stories.title: Jef Van gestel en Cheroney Pelupessy winnen Gieskes-Strijbis Podiumprijs 2026

en.title: Jef Van gestel and Cheroney Pelupessy win Gieskes-Strijbis Podiumprijs 2026
en.summary: Belgian theater maker Jef Van gestel and choreographer Cheroney Pelupessy have won the tenth edition of the Gieskes-Strijbis Podiumprijs, the Netherlands' largest stage arts prize. The award recognizes two artists annually for their contributions to diversity in Dutch stage arts.

stories.title: Danseres Cheroney Pelupessy en performer Jef Van gestel winnen dit jaar de Gieskes-Strijbis Podiumprijs

en.title: Dancer Cheroney Pelupessy and performer Jef Van gestel win this year's Gieskes-Strijbis Podiumprijs
en.summary: Cheroney Pelupessy and Jef Van gestel have won the Gieskes-Strijbis Podiumprijs.

stories.title: Burgemeester: agenten liepen gehoorschade op bij anti-azc-rellen Opheusden

en.title: Mayor: officers suffered hearing damage during anti-asylum center riots in Opheusden
en.summary: The mayor of Neder-Betuwe reports that four police officers sustained hearing damage during anti-asylum protests in Opheusden when demonstrators threw heavy fireworks at them. Officers required emergency medical treatment following the incidents.

stories.title: Jemen kondigt ‘tegenoffensief’ aan tegen Houthi’s; beide partijen claimen meteen successen

en.title: Yemen announces 'counteroffensive' against Houthis; both parties immediately claim successes
en.summary: Yemen has announced a counteroffensive against the Houthis, with both sides quickly claiming military successes.

stories.title: Een alg die extreem snel op licht reageert leidde tot een revolutie in de hersenwetenschap - en een Nobelprijs voor Geneeskunde

en.title: An alga that responds extremely quickly to light led to a revolution in neuroscience - and a Nobel Prize in Medicine
en.summary: Three scientists received the Nobel Prize in Medicine for discovering how to activate and deactivate brain cells using light, advancing understanding of how the brain works.

stories.title: Nobelprijs voor geneeskunde naar optogenetica: een lichtknopje in de hersenen

en.title: Nobel Prize in Medicine awarded for optogenetics: a light switch in the brain
en.summary: A light-sensitive molecule discovered in algae was found to function as a control mechanism across different organisms, including potential applications in human brain research through the technique called optogenetics.

stories.title: Vijftienjarige jongen verliest hand bij aanhoudende protesten in Frankrijk

en.title: Fifteen-year-old boy loses hand during ongoing protests in France
en.summary: A teenage student lost his hand after picking up a tear gas canister during protests in France. Schools across the country have closed for a second consecutive week due to safety concerns.

stories.title: Nobelprijs voor de Geneeskunde voor ‘optogenetica’, futuristische manier om hersencellen van buitenaf te besturen

en.title: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine awarded for 'optogenetics', futuristic method to control brain cells from outside
en.summary: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded for research in optogenetics, a technique that enables external control of brain cells.
